title: Claude installed and worked once but then will not run again.
body:
I was able to get in once and went through the sign-up and purchased credits.  I ran it in a directory and it worked.  I then quit and tried again to run in a different directory and claude was not recongnized.

>npm install @anthropic-ai/claude-code

added 3 packages, and audited 11 packages in 386ms

2 packages are looking for funding
  run `npm fund` for details

found 0 vulnerabilities

>claude
claude: command not found


I have tried removing and installing again and it does not change.  Rebooting doesn't help either. 
Ubuntu 24.04.2
author: rmaxseiner
